label: Customer.io

tools.name: AggregateCampaignMetrics
tools.description: Read a campaign's aggregate delivery metrics over a period.

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Id of the campaign whose metrics to read.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Granularity of the metric series. Defaults to days.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Number of periods to report, counting back from now. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: AggregateNewsletterMetrics
tools.description: Read a newsletter's aggregate delivery metrics over a period.

parameters.name: newsletter_id
parameters.description: Id of the newsletter whose metrics to read.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Granularity of the metric series. Defaults to days.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Number of periods to report, counting back from now. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: CreatePersonEvent
tools.description:
Record a named custom event on a person's timeline to drive lifecycle
journeys.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Id of the person the event is recorded against.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the custom event (e.g. purchased, signed_up).

parameters.name: identifier_type
parameters.description: Which kind of value person_id is, so the event targets the right profile. Defaults to the external id you assigned the person; use the Customer.io internal id when person_id is a cio_id (people with no external id are returned that way), or email when it is an email address.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Event data as a flat mapping of property name to value. Defaults to an event with no data.

tools.name: DeletePerson
tools.description:
Delete a person record to honor a data-removal request.

Deleting a person who does not exist is accepted as a no-op.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Id of the person to delete.

parameters.name: identifier_type
parameters.description: Which kind of value person_id is, so the delete targets the right profile. Defaults to the external id you assigned the person; use the Customer.io internal id when person_id is a cio_id (people with no external id are returned that way), or email when it is an email address.

tools.name: GetPerson
tools.description:
Look up a person's profile by email or id.

Resolves the person by whichever identifier is supplied; an email shared by
several people reports every match in the result.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address to look up the person by. Provide this or a person id. Defaults to looking up by person id.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Customer.io person id to look up. Provide this or an email. Defaults to looking up by email.

tools.name: ListBroadcasts
tools.description: List the workspace's broadcasts to discover ids that can be triggered.

tools.name: ListCampaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns in the workspace.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum campaigns to return (1-1000). Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0-indexed starting position. Defaults to 0 (first result).

tools.name: ListNewsletters
tools.description: List the newsletters in the workspace.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum newsletters to return (1-1000). Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0-indexed starting position. Defaults to 0 (first result).

tools.name: ListPeople
tools.description:
Find people by segment membership and/or an attribute, to build an
audience without a known id. Supply at least one of a segment or an
attribute name; both combine with AND.

parameters.name: segment_id
parameters.description: Restrict to members of this segment. Defaults to any segment.

parameters.name: attribute_name
parameters.description: Restrict to people who have this attribute. Combine with an attribute value to match a specific value, or leave the value empty to match anyone the attribute is set on. Defaults to no attribute filter.

parameters.name: attribute_value
parameters.description: Value the named attribute must equal. Ignored unless an attribute name is given. Defaults to any value the attribute is set to.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum people to return (1-1000). Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a prior page. Defaults to an empty string, which returns the first page.

tools.name: ListPersonActivities
tools.description:
List a person's recent activities, most recent first, resolved by email
or id. Optionally filter by activity type and/or name; filtering by name
requires an activity type. When an email matches several people, the first
match's activities are returned.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Customer.io person id. Provide this or an email. Defaults to looking up by email.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email of the person. Provide this or a person id. Defaults to looking up by person id.

parameters.name: activity_type
parameters.description: Restrict to one activity type. Defaults to all types.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Restrict to activities with this exact name (e.g. an event name). Requires an activity type to also be set. Defaults to any name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum activities to return (1-1000). Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a prior page. Defaults to the first page.

tools.name: ListPersonMessages
tools.description:
List a person's message and delivery history, most recent first,
resolved by email or id. When an email matches several people, the first
match's messages are returned.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Customer.io person id. Provide this or an email. Defaults to looking up by email.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email of the person. Provide this or a person id. Defaults to looking up by person id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum messages to return (1-1000). Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a prior page. Defaults to the first page.

tools.name: ListPersonSegments
tools.description:
List the segments a person belongs to, resolved by email or id. When an
email matches several people, the first match's segments are returned.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Customer.io person id. Provide this or an email. Defaults to looking up by email.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email of the person. Provide this or a person id. Defaults to looking up by person id.

tools.name: ListSegmentMembers
tools.description: List the ids of the people in a segment and the segment's total size.

parameters.name: segment_id
parameters.description: Id of the segment whose members to list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum member ids to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a prior page. Defaults to the first page.

tools.name: ListSegments
tools.description: List the segments defined in the workspace.

tools.name: ListTransactionalMessages
tools.description: List the transactional message templates in the workspace.

tools.name: SavePerson
tools.description:
Create or update a person and their attributes.

Existing attributes not named in this call are preserved; named attributes
are added or overwritten.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: Stable id that identifies the person; creates the person if new.

parameters.name: identifier_type
parameters.description: Which kind of value person_id is, so the write targets the right profile. Defaults to the external id you assigned the person; use the Customer.io internal id when person_id is a cio_id (people with no external id are returned that way), or email when it is an email address.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email to set on the person. Provided values are stored as the email attribute. Defaults to leaving the email unchanged.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Attributes to set or update on the person, as a flat mapping of attribute name to value. Defaults to leaving all attributes unchanged.

tools.name: SendTransactionalEmail
tools.description: Send a transactional email to one recipient by its template id.

parameters.name: transactional_message_id
parameters.description: Id of the transactional message template to send.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Recipient email address. The send is associated with the person who has this email; provide an email address, not a person id.

parameters.name: message_data
parameters.description: Values for the template's variables, as a flat mapping of name to value. Defaults to no variables.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Subject line override. Defaults to the template's subject.

parameters.name: from_address
parameters.description: From address override. Defaults to the template's sender.

parameters.name: bcc
parameters.description: BCC address. Defaults to no BCC.

parameters.name: reply_to
parameters.description: Reply-to address override. Defaults to the template's reply-to.

tools.name: StartBroadcast
tools.description: Trigger an API broadcast to a segment or an explicit recipient list.

parameters.name: broadcast_id
parameters.description: Id of the API-triggered broadcast to launch.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Trigger data referenced by the broadcast's content/liquid, as a flat mapping of name to value. Defaults to no data.

parameters.name: segment_id
parameters.description: Segment id to send to. Defaults to the broadcast's configured audience or an explicit recipient list.

parameters.name: recipient_ids
parameters.description: Explicit external customer ids to send to (the id you assigned the person, not a Customer.io cio_id). Defaults to targeting a segment, recipient emails, or the configured audience.

parameters.name: recipient_emails
parameters.description: Explicit recipient email addresses to send to. Prefer this when you only have an email or a cio_id. Defaults to targeting a segment or ids.

summary:
Customer.io is a customer engagement platform for sending lifecycle, broadcast, newsletter, and transactional messages. This Arcade toolkit exposes tools for managing people, segments, campaigns, and messaging across a Customer.io workspace.

## Capabilities

- **People management** — look up, create, update, and delete person profiles; record custom events on a person's timeline to drive lifecycle journeys.
- **Audience & segmentation** — list all workspace segments, query segment membership, find people by segment and/or attribute, and list the segments a specific person belongs to.
- **Activity & message history** — retrieve a person's recent activities (filterable by type and name) and their full message/delivery history.
- **Campaigns, newsletters & broadcasts** — list campaigns, newsletters, and broadcasts; read aggregate delivery metrics for campaigns and newsletters; trigger API broadcasts to a segment or an explicit recipient list.
- **Transactional messaging** — list transactional message templates and send a transactional email to a single recipient by template ID.

## Secrets

All secrets are supplied as environment-level configuration. No OAuth flow is involved.

- **`CUSTOMERIO_APP_API_KEY`** — A Customer.io App API key, used for the [App API](https://customer.io/docs/api/app/) (people lookup, segments, campaigns, metrics, etc.). Generate one in the Customer.io dashboard under **Settings → API Credentials → App API Keys**. The key requires appropriate workspace permissions; account owner or admin access is typically needed to create keys.

- **`CUSTOMERIO_TRACKING_API_KEY`** — A Customer.io Tracking API key (also called the API Key in the track credentials section), used for the [Track API](https://customer.io/docs/api/track/) (creating/updating people, recording events). Found in the Customer.io dashboard under **Settings → API Credentials → Tracking API Keys** alongside the Site ID.

- **`CUSTOMERIO_SITE_ID`** — The Site ID paired with the Tracking API key for your Customer.io workspace. Located in the same **Settings → API Credentials → Tracking API Keys** screen as the Tracking API key. Required to authenticate Track API calls.

- **`CUSTOMERIO_REGION`** — The data region your Customer.io workspace is hosted in (e.g., `us` or `eu`). Determines which API base URLs are used. Find your region in the Customer.io dashboard under **Settings → Workspace Settings**; it matches the subdomain you log in through (`fly.customer.io` for US, `fly.eu.customer.io` for EU).

For instructions on storing secrets in Arcade, see [Create Tool Secrets](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets). You can manage your secrets at [https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
